example_prompt: Check how many Intron credits are left before sending a batch of audio files.

balance.description: the current available credits balance on the account

currency.description: the currency the balance is denominated in

status.description: "success" in the documented example (not "Ok" as on the transcription endpoints).

gotchas: The API key comes from the developers tab of your account on voice.intron.io; send it as 'Authorization: Bearer {key}' from your backend only — the docs say never expose it in client-side code.
currency depends on the country set on the account: NGN for Nigeria (NG), USD for every other country. Don't assume USD.
The body's status is "success" here, while transcription endpoints return "Ok".
Error bodies (invalid key, rate limit) are not documented.
Rate limit: 100 requests per minute on accounts/v1/balance. Responses carry rate-limit headers; Retry-After gives the delay in seconds before retrying.

spans: If your account country is NG (Nigeria), the currency will be NGN; for all other countries, the currency will be USD.
the current available credits balance on the account
